messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 GPU queue growth detected: gpu-serving-prod queue length +420 over 10m, avg latency per request 4.8s, autoscaler at nodepool max (12/12). Autoscaler events: scale_refused (max_nodes_reached). Paging oncall: @oncall-alex
oncall-alex: ack — jumping in. Any immediate customer-facing errors?
support-jamie: seeing elevated 429s on inference API for a handful of customers (mostly batch/embedding jobs), error rate ~3.6% last 5m. I've opened a support ticket for the largest customer, will DM updates.
sre-maya: confirmed cluster event logs: HPA/cluster-autoscaler refused scale due to nodePool.maxNodes hit. Pod backlog increasing, a few pods stuck in Pending with PendingScheduling. Some OOM evictions earlier but not correlated.
infra-ron: which nodepool? region-eu-gpu-pool-1 (A100s). Current node count 12, max configured 12. We have spare capacity in us-east but cross-region routing not enabled for this service.
eng-tiago: is there a compatible model variant in a different pool we can route to as fallback (e.g., quantized variant on cpu or smaller GPU)?
sre-maya: routing fallback exists but requires model-variant registration and is behind a feature flag for this customer tier. Not automatic. We can trigger shard-level reroute but need approval.
pm-lina: (cc) Customer SLAs? If we take manual action, do we need to notify CS/legal?
support-jamie: for the largest affected customer they are on business tier with 99.9% inference SLA. Incident likely to violate if not mitigated in next 20m. They already have an open support ticket. Recommend we prioritize.
oncall-alex: triage plan: 1) quick assessment of risk for manual node cap raise; 2) attempt temporary routing to us-east as fallback; 3) if both blocked, request manual nodepool max increase from infra. Assign roles: infra-ron will assess cap raise safety, eng-tiago + sre-maya evaluate routing fallback, support-jamie will handle customer comms.
infra-ron: safety check: recent node provisioning in eu-west region had a transient image pull regression earlier today but fixed. Quota limits: current project CPU/GPU quota in eu-west allows +8 A100s, but there is an org-level soft quota of 20 A100s across projects — we are at 18 total. Manual increase may need approval from cloud-ops.
sre-maya: quick test: can we cordon a smaller non-prod nodepool and move some low-priority jobs to free up capacity?
eng-tiago: low-priority batch can be paused, but embeddings are time-sensitive; moving will take ~10-15m and may not resolve immediate backlog.
oncall-alex: time box 10m for the routing fallback check. If it fails, escalate for manual cap raise.
(5m later)
eng-tiago: tried on-the-fly routing: attempted to register fallback variant, hit permissions error — `403: variant.create denied`. Need infra API key with model-service write scope.
sre-maya: tried scaling down dev nodepool to free quota — dev > prod migration blocked by taints/tolerations and service accounts; would need reconfig which is risky mid-incident.
infra-ron: given permissions + quota constraints, manual nodepool max bump is the fastest. I'll request emergency quota bump from cloud-ops and prepare an infra-side change to nodepool max to 20. Need authorization from an SRE lead or Eng manager to proceed.
pm-lina: I authorize temporary increase to 20 nodes for eu-gpu pool for 60m emergency window. Notify legal if this becomes recurring.
infra-ron: starting manual change. Steps: 1) patch nodepool max -> 20; 2) trigger autoscaler reconcile; 3) monitor for provisioning errors. Command: 
```bash
# GKE node pool patch (example)
gcloud container node-pools update eu-gpu-pool-1 --cluster=prod-cluster --max-nodes=20 --region=europe-west1
```
I'll run this in 2m. Rolling back plan: revert max-nodes to 12 after traffic normalizes, drain any surplus nodes before delete.
(2m later)
infra-ron: ran update, autoscaler reconcile triggered. New desired nodes provisioning: 6 requested, currently provisioning 3. Cloud-ops acknowledged quota bump (temporary).
sre-maya: seeing Pending pods start to schedule onto new nodes. Token-level latency dropping: now 2.1s avg. Queue length decreasing.
support-jamie: informed primary customer: "We are provisioning additional capacity to mitigate the impact; ETA ~10-15m. We'll follow up once stabilized." They replied :thumbsup:.
oncall-alex: great. Keep monitoring for 30m. If errors persist, we will consider applying temporary routing fallback and a post-incident config freeze.
(10m later)
incident-bot: Update: queue length down to +30, avg latency 1.4s, error rate 0.4%. Autoscaler now at 18/20 nodes.
sre-maya: performance looks back to normal baseline. No new 429 spikes.
infra-ron: leaving nodepool max at 20 for guardrail period of 1h, then will reduce to 12 after we confirm stability. Will create a follow-up PR to document the temporary bump and approval.
pm-lina: please add a customer-impact blurb for the postmortem. Jamie, can you capture support ticket numbers and timelines?
support-jamie: done — ticket #CS-4421, initial report at 1759994300, mitigation started 1759994370, capacity online 1759994490. Will paste full thread in the postmortem doc.
eng-tiago: action items: 1) enable cross-region fallback for embedding workload (eng + infra design change) 2) automate fallback for quantized variants 3) add autoscaler alert threshold for "max_nodes_reached" to page infra earlier.
oncall-alex: assigning owners: eng-tiago (fallback design), infra-ron (quota + automation), sre-maya (alert + runbook update), support-jamie (customer comms + timeline).
incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated — capacity increased manually, routing fallback blocked by permissions. Postmortem required.
oncall-alex: ending handoff: I will create an incident postmortem and schedule a 30m review in 2 days. Thanks all — good run. :clap:
